name.ja: BB戦士412 貂蝉キュベレイ&武将座

description.ja: • 「BB戦士三国伝」10周年を記念して、Blu-ray BOXでしか入手できなった幻のキット“麗しき女将軍”貂蝉キュベレイが装いを新たに再キット化！
description.en: • To commemorate the 10th anniversary of "BB Senshi Sangokuden ", the phantom Kit " Beautiful Female General" Diao Chan Qubeley, who was only available on Blu-ray BOX, has been re-kitted with a new outfit!

description.ja: • 成形色はより華やかで鮮やかな色へ変更され、目のデザインをBB戦士フォーマットに変更！
description.en: • The molding color has been changed to a more gorgeous and vivid color, and the eye design has been changed to the BB warrior format!

description.ja: • 貂蝉キュベレイのイメージにあわせた紫の武将座が付属する！
description.en: • Comes with a purple military commander's seat that matches the image of Diaochan Qubeley!

description.ja: • さらに、パッケージイラストは新規描き起こしとなっている！
description.en: • In addition, the package illustration has been newly drawn!
